theorems.statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)) (μ : Measure (Eucl P)) (v : Eucl P → NVector (Eucl P) k), (∀ K : Set (Eucl P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μ K < ∞) → (∀ (x : Eucl P) (α : Covector (Eucl P) k), |v x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α) → (∀ α : Covector (Eucl P) k, Measurable (fun x => v x α)) → (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ∃ α : Covector (Eucl P) k, covectorEuclideanNorm α ≤ 1 ∧ v x α = 1) → ∀ A : Set (Eucl P), MeasurableSet A → ∀ W : Set (Eucl P), IsOpen W → W ⊆ U → ∀ c : ℝ≥0∞, c < μ (W ∩ A) → ∃ φ : Eucl P → Covector (Eucl P) k, Continuous φ ∧ HasCompactSupport φ ∧ tsupport φ ⊆ W ∧ (∀ x, covectorEuclideanNorm (φ x) ≤ 1) ∧ c < ENNReal.ofReal (∫ x in A, v x (φ x) ∂μ)
